run_gender_dist_hf_dataset: run gender distribution analysis on a HuggingFace dataset using --hf_datasets with --first_level_key and --split
run_gender_dist_text_files: run gender distribution analysis on local text files using --file_dir and --file_names arguments
run_gender_dist_lang_detect: run gender distribution analysis with automatic language detection via --lang_detect when no --langs provided
run_gender_dist_latex_report: run gender distribution analysis and print a LaTeX table summary using --printout_latex
run_gender_dist_csv_report: run gender distribution analysis and export results to a CSV file in --write_dir
